navigation-menu-demo.reason: The Docs link has navigationMenuTriggerStyle() over the link's own classes. Upstream's cn() merges them with tailwind-merge, so the trigger's px-2.5 py-1.5 win over the link's p-2; in Joinery's style sheet the link rule comes after the trigger rule and its p-2 wins, so the link is 4px narrower, and the centred menu, its text only a few pixels tall, moves 2px. Everything else matches.

navigation-menu-rtl.reason: As navigation-menu-demo: the Docs link's padding is the link rule's p-2, not the trigger's px-2.5 py-1.5 that upstream's tailwind-merge keeps, so the centred menu moves 2px.
